speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) supports the Government’s policies and programmes through a sound fiscal system that plans for the future, and an effective and efficient Government that innovates and delivers value for money.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: The shifts in global economic trends, ageing and far-reaching innovations brought about by technology, present opportunities to transform the economy.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: To sharpen our competitive edge, MOF is partnering Government agencies to strengthen Singapore’s position as a Global-Asia node of technology, innovation and enterprise.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We are investing in making innovation pervasive, deepening capabilities in our firms and workers, and forging partnerships with businesses and trade associations to drive industry-level advancements.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We regularly review our corporate regulations to ensure we have an efficient, transparent and business-friendly environment.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will partner the private sector to co-create solutions for businesses, and harness technology to improve services for businesses and citizens.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: As the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Chair in 2018, we are promoting ASEAN financial integration with initiatives to sustain growth, boost resilience and foster innovation for the region.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will continue to support Singapore’s development as a smart, green and liveable city.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Major investments will be made to rejuvenate ageing infrastructure, develop new districts and transport networks, and enhance our air, sea and land links.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will invest in Strategic National Projects that lay the foundation for a Smart Nation and strengthen our connectivity to the world.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: MOF will continue to support individuals and families, strengthen partnerships between the Government and the community and encourage a spirit of giving through SG Cares.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We are investing heavily in preschool, education and skills upgrading to ensure that citizens have opportunities to develop their potential throughout life.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will support Singaporeans to stay healthy, make informed healthcare choices and prepare for their healthcare needs in old age.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will also continue to expand our healthcare capacity and strengthen long-term care, while moderating the growth in healthcare costs.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will do more to strengthen our families and enable our seniors to stay active, contribute meaningfully, and age with confidence.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will promote sports, arts and heritage, philanthropy and volunteerism to build common interests for a stronger society.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Singapore is on a sound fiscal footing today because we have always emphasised prudent spending and built resilient and broad-based revenue sources.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We have also invested our resources wisely and used our investment returns in sustainable ways.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We must continue to maintain a sound and sustainable fiscal system and ensure a balanced Budget over the medium term.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: On the revenue side, we have to adjust to changes in the global environment that could impact our competitiveness.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: As we build up our revenues, we will ensure that taxes remain competitive to encourage private enterprise and individual initiative.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will continue to keep our overall tax and transfer system equitable, fair and progressive.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will also continue to seek the best value for the money we spend.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will leverage the strength of our financial position to optimise our borrowing and invest sustainably in longer-term infrastructure that will position Singapore well for the future.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will continue to be good stewards of our Reserves.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will harness our fiscal resources prudently and responsibly, so as to advance the well-being of all Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will do so in partnership with citizens and the community.
